meta.dataset: FAO Food Price Index, annual averages, nominal (2014-2016=100)
meta.note: Annual averages of the monthly index. Values for 2009-2025 were verified against FAO, Food Outlook (June 2026), Table 4.4 (print p. 85 / PDF p. 98). Values for 2000-2008 come from the FAO-derived annual-values series in the manual CSV and have not been independently re-verified against a primary FAO table - see data/manual/fao-food-price-index.csv and docs/limitations.md. March 2022 monthly peak: 160.3 points.
